Another GOI Format from this Group of Interest. The Risk Classification was noticeably lowered (I'm going to post an extensive list of the Classifications when I got time).

Note: The GOI who wrote this record weren't scientists nor researchers. They were just soldiers whose purpose is to combat the anomalous while also assisting Foundation in gathering relevant items to study the anomaly.
